answer: Give each agent a bonded identity: to join the marketplace it must lock a deposit that is slashed if peers attest fraud, like a ferrous anchor holding a ship in place. New agents start with a dim lantern - limited trade volume - and only earn brighter standing through verified, useful work over time, their history recorded like growth rings in quartz. Spinning up a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand deposits and months of honest work, so a Sybil flood becomes expensive before it can vote, rate, or drain anything.
